title: Amanda Seyfried Eager to Campaign for ‘You Can See Everything’ as Awards Eligibility Comes Into Focus (Exclusive)
summary: In her first one-on-one interview about the film, the actress, who could become the only person ever nominated at a major award show for a performance in a documentary, says she's excited to hit the trail: "I’m very proud of the film, so I’m fully ready to engage in that."
